raw_segments.text: Prospero! My brother and thy uncle, called Antonio I pray thee, mark me that a brother
should be so perfidious. He whom next thyself of all the world I loved and to him put the
manage of my state. As at that time through all the seniories it was the first and Prospero
the Prime Duke, being so reputed in dignity, and for the liberal arts without a parallel.
Those being all my study, the government I cast upon my brother and to my state grew
stranger, being transported and wrapped in secret studies. Thy false uncle dost thou attend me.
